sentence: Never before ___ I seen such a magnificent performance.
tip: Inversión: después de <Never before> el auxiliar va antes del sujeto
explanation: Después de <Never before>, se usa el orden invertido: <had I seen>.

sentence: It is essential that he ___ on time.
tip: Subjuntivo: después de <It is essential that> se usa la forma base del verbo
explanation: Subjuntivo después de <it is essential that>: forma base <be>, no <is>.

sentence: ___ in the garden, she noticed a rare butterfly.
tip: Cláusula de participio presente: ¿qué hacía mientras notó la mariposa?
explanation: Cláusula de participio presente: <Walking in the garden> = While she was walking.

sentence: The data, ___ over five years, revealed significant trends.
tip: Cláusula de participio pasado: los datos fueron... durante 5 años
explanation: Cláusula de participio pasado: <collected over five years> = which was collected.

sentence: She managed to ___ through the difficult negotiations successfully.
tip: Phrasal verb: ___ through = salir adelante a pesar de dificultades
explanation: El phrasal verb <pull through> significa lograr salir adelante a pesar de las dificultades.

sentence: The committee decided to ___ aside the controversial proposal.
tip: Phrasal verb: ___ aside = dejar de lado, hacer caso omiso
explanation: El phrasal verb <set aside> significa dejar algo de lado o hacer caso omiso de ello.

sentence: He ___ up to the challenge and delivered an excellent presentation.
tip: Phrasal verb: ___ up to = superar un desafío (pasado irregular)
explanation: El phrasal verb <rise up to> significa superar un desafío con éxito.

sentence: The new policy ___ about significant changes in the department.
tip: Phrasal verb: ___ about = causar que algo suceda (pasado irregular)
explanation: El phrasal verb <bring about> significa causar que algo suceda.

sentence: We need to ___ into account all the variables before deciding.
tip: Phrasal verb: ___ into account = tener en cuenta
explanation: El phrasal verb <take into account> significa tener algo en cuenta.

sentence: She ___ down the offer despite the generous salary.
tip: Phrasal verb: ___ down = rechazar (pasado)
explanation: El phrasal verb <turn down> significa rechazar o denegar.

sentence: He's burning the candle at both ends. He's ___ himself by working too much.
tip: Modismo: quemar la vela por ambos extremos = ¿qué se hace a sí mismo?
explanation: El modismo <burning the candle at both ends> significa trabajar en exceso y agotarse.

sentence: She hit the nail on the head with her analysis. She was exactly ___.
tip: Modismo: 'dar en el clavo' = tener la razón exacta. Ella estaba...
explanation: El modismo <hit the nail on the head> significa acertar exactamente.

sentence: The new regulations opened a can of worms. They created many new ___.
tip: Modismo: 'abrir una lata de gusanos' = generar muchos...
explanation: El modismo <open a can of worms> significa crear muchos problemas nuevos.

sentence: He's sitting on the fence about the decision. He's ___.
tip: Modismo: 'sentarse en la cerca' = no elegir un lado. Está...
explanation: El modismo <sitting on the fence> significa estar indeciso o mantenerse neutral.

sentence: The amelior___ of living conditions is a priority.
tip: Sufijo -ation: convierte <ameliorate> en sustantivo
explanation: Al añadir <-ation> a <ameliorate> se forma el sustantivo <amelioration> (mejora).

sentence: His argument was completely ___logical.
tip: Prefijo de negación para palabras con 'l': ¿cuál es?
explanation: El prefijo <il-> antes de palabras que empiezan con 'l' significa 'no': <illogical>.

sentence: The ___ of the research was questioned by peer reviewers.
tip: Formación: <valid> + sufijo sustantivo (-ity) → ?
explanation: Al añadir <-ity> a <valid> se forma el sustantivo <validity>.

sentence: She spoke with great ___ence about the topic.
tip: Formación: <eloquent> → sustantivo cambiando -ent por -ence
explanation: Cambiar <-ent> por <-ence>: <eloquent> → <eloquence>.

sentence: The phenomenon, ___ complex, can be explained simply.
tip: Reduced clause — shorten 'Although it is complex' to a single linking word + adjective
explanation: Cláusula reducida: <though complex> = although it is complex.

sentence: ___ had the meeting started than the fire alarm went off.
tip: Inversión: ___ had... than = secuencia inmediata (2 palabras)
explanation: Estructura invertida: <No sooner had... than> expresa una secuencia inmediata.
